source_artwork.review: Both branches, the punctured line, and four original double arrows were retained. The PDF extracts arrow glyphs as x, y and extension parts.

source_notes.note: The density characterization says every open subset, without the nonempty qualifier. Translated as printed.
The existence proof in Proposition/Definition 11.21 prints ∈ for the projective subvarieties in projective space. Retained.
Exercise 11.2.1 names X as the topological space and X ⊆ Y as the subset; Exercise 11.2.2 omits a nonempty qualifier for open sets. Translated without silently changing either.
The assertion following Example 11.30 is stated for any projective variety without an irreducibility qualifier; retained as printed.
Exercise 11.4.1 names the full projective conic rather than removing V(w), unlike the referenced example. Both source expressions are retained.
